prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A fast guide to three days in Lisbon, from hilltop views and trams to custard tarts and grilled fish. Plan your sights and meals day by day.

beats.narration: Three days in Lisbon? You'll climb hills, ride yellow trams, and eat your way through the city. Here's your plan.
Day one, wander the old neighborhoods and catch sunset from a hilltop viewpoint. Day two, head to the riverside and historic monuments.
Eat custard tarts warm, grilled fish by the water, and sip coffee slowly. Day three, take it easy. Lisbon rewards slow travelers.
